pattern: 切りがない（きりがない）
purpose: Say that a process or list has no practical end.
keywords: Vたら / ば + 切りがない; N + は切りがない
There is no end to counting the flaws.
Once you start worrying, there is no end to it.
There is always someone above you.
formation: Vたら / ば + 切りがない; N + は切りがない
restrictions: Often explains why one must stop or limit something.
mistake: 切り means an endpoint here, not a physical cut.
